description: Coupled Bianchi-I moduli ODE and stability analysis on T^3 (Exploratory Toy)

driven_moduli_analysis.modulus_drift_note: Steady velocity v != 0 causes continuous modulus drift unless an un-modeled potential provides stationary stabilization.

epistemic_verdict.finding: Free Casimir stress decays strictly to spatial isotropy Ht/Hp = 1.000000 at a=1 (z=0). Driven model requires exact eta = 27/76 (~0.3553) for Ht/Hp = 13/12, but steady velocity causes modulus drift without potential stabilization.
